newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gran Canaria cargo traffic rose 26 percent in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Gran Canaria cargo traffic rose 26 percent in Jan.

text.p: Spain's Gran Canaria airport handled 26.2 percent more cargo in January compared with the same month last year, the airport authority said.
Volume rose to 3,927 tonnes compared with 3,135 tonnes.
In 1996 Gran Canaria's cargo totalled 34,671 tonnes, a 5.1 percent increase on 1995.
The airport also handled 483 tonnes of mail in January, a 36 percent increase from January 1996.

Passenger numbers were 1.3 percent higher in the month at 710,220 excluding transit passengers. For 1996 as a whole passenger numbers rose 0.5 percent to 7.67 million. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
